# Avocado Digital

> Avocado Digital (Avocado Pty Ltd) is a small Australian software and strategy studio, established 2021 in Melbourne, building durable tools for small and medium businesses — bespoke software, curated technology, strategy consulting and LEX Waypoint (leads-to-matter analytics and intake improvement for Australian law firms, part of EzyBiz LEX), plus four products of its own: EzyBiz LEX, Call Concierge, SocialReels and Claudette.

Key facts:

- Services: Workflow Solutions (bespoke software and workflow automation), Curated Technology (pragmatic tool selection and integration), Strategy Consulting (strategy intensives, roadmap shaping, pre-mortems, fractional CTO), LEX Waypoint (leads-to-matter analytics and intake improvement for Australian law firms, part of EzyBiz LEX).
- Legal entity: Avocado Pty Ltd, ACN 652 199 687, ABN 81 652 199 687.
- Contact: hello@avocadodigital.com.au · Reception +61 3 6358 8887

## Products

- [EzyBiz LEX](https://ezybizlex.com.au/): the ultimate business phone for legal professionals — a dedicated business number with an Australian AI answering service (call screening, message taking, appointment booking) and every call filed to the right matter in Smokeball or Clio. Legal pages: https://ezybizlex.com.au/terms/, https://ezybizlex.com.au/privacy/, https://ezybizlex.com.au/acceptable-use/, https://ezybizlex.com.au/data-residency/.
- [Call Concierge](https://callconcierge.com.au): live Australian new-client intake for law firms, connected to EzyBiz.
- [SocialReels](https://socialreels.ai): short-form video for small business (private beta).
- [Claudette](https://github.com/Avocado-Pty-Ltd/Claudette): an open-source, voice-based IDE that turns speech into a working codebase (MIT licence, on GitHub).

## Services

- [Workflow Solutions](https://avocadodigital.com.au/workflow-solutions.html): bespoke software and workflow automation
- [Curated Technology](https://avocadodigital.com.au/curated-tech.html): tool selection and integration
- [Strategy Consulting](https://avocadodigital.com.au/strategy-consulting.html): strategy intensives, roadmaps, fractional CTO
- [LEX Waypoint](https://lexwaypoint.avocadodigital.com.au/): leads-to-matter analytics and intake improvement for Australian law firms, part of EzyBiz LEX. It follows every call, text and web enquiry to the matter it became in Smokeball or Clio (calls and texts through EzyBiz LEX; forms, inboxes and spend per channel imported), with results in EzyBiz LEX Desktop. Everything is measured on leads to matter, the share of genuine enquiries (excluding spam and requests for work the firm doesn't do) that become opened matters, broken down by lead source (SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, referrals, directories such as LawConnect), contact method (calls, web forms, emails, messages) and response (response time, missed calls, drop-off before a matter opens). Three plans, each adding to the one before: Waypoint Insight (EzyBiz LEX calls and texts matched to matters, enquiry log import, leads-to-matter dashboard, response-time and missed-call analysis, site and intake audit, monthly intake report), Waypoint Growth (intake fixes with Call Concierge or EzyBiz LEX, missed-call text-back, callback targets, better contact forms, source tracking with tracking numbers and UTM/gclid capture, Business Profile management and review requests, money pages signed off by the firm's lawyers) and Waypoint Leadership (full SEO programme built around the firm's suburbs, multi-location support, cost-per-matter reporting by source). Google Ads management is a separate add-on available with any plan, reported on cost per matter. It was previously called Law Firm Intake; it now has its own site at lexwaypoint.avocadodigital.com.au, and the old /lex-waypoint.html, /law-firm-intake.html and /legal-seo.html URLs redirect there.
